item.description:

A 30-year-old man was convicted of causing the 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles, which killed 12 and destroyed 6,800 homes. The fire caused $150 billion in damage. The man, a former Uber driver, faces up to 40 years in prison. The fire was one of the deadliest in LA County history.
